messages:
Amelia (Docs): Heads-up — we're shipping the v1->v2 deprecation notice next week. Need to sync on localized copies + example snippets.
Ryan (i18n): Thanks — which pages are we localizing?
Amelia (Docs): All public deprecation pages + migration guide and the quickstart snippets. URL: https://docs.redwood.com/migration/v1-to-v2 (working draft).
Lisa (Translations): I can coordinate translations. Recommend we extract the short banners + the migration steps only (not the full examples) for initial pass.
Sanjay (SDK): Quick note: our SDK examples embed code with `idempotency_key` and timestamp formatting — those will need locale-aware comments. Also some snippets use MM/DD/YYYY, which is bad in EU.
Marco (PM): Agree. Priority: 1) banner copy 2) migration checklist 3) quickstart code examples. Locale set: en, fr, de, ja, ko, es.
Amelia (Docs): Planner: create a docs PR that adds a `i18n-deprecation` label; each translation PR should reference the English docs PR. Can @docbot post PR templates?
docbot: New PR template created: "docs/i18n-deprecation-template". Use label `i18n-deprecation`.
Lisa (Translations): I'll open a tracker spreadsheet and assign language owners. Can we get the canonical strings in a JSON key:value file so translators don't have to hunt?
Amelia (Docs): Yes — I'll add /content/deprecations/v1_to_v2/strings.json in the PR. Format: keys like `banner_title`, `banner_body_short`, `migration_step_1`. Keep entries short.
Sanjay (SDK): For examples, can we split code into two parts in the doc: logic + locale note? e.g., show code with UTC ISO timestamps then a note: "format for display is locale-specific". That reduces translation burden.
Amelia (Docs): Good idea. Also add a snippet comment: `// example uses ISO-8601 timestamps; convert for display` so translators don't change code.
Ryan (i18n): We should avoid translating inline variable names and internal config keys. Put an explicit rule in the PR description: "Do not translate code identifiers, config keys, or error codes."
Lisa (Translations): Noted. Also: what about screenshots? The migration guide has one screenshot with a UI message that includes copy. We need to either remove or add language-specific screenshots.
Marco (PM): Let's remove the screenshot for now and replace with a small UI copy block that can be localized easily. Screenshot re-add can be a follow-up.
Amelia (Docs): Action items: 1) I'll open the English docs PR with strings.json + example split + label. 2) @Ryan will review language extraction. 3) @Lisa opens translation PRs referencing the English PR. 4) @Sanjay will update SDK snippets to include the single ISO-8601 standard and a locale note.
Sanjay (SDK): I'll prepare a small patch for the JS, Python snippets — change date examples to `2025-02-20T15:30:00Z` and add comment.
Ryan (i18n): I'll run a quick regex to ensure no MM/DD/YYYY left: `\b(0?[1-9]|1[0-2])\/[0-3]?\d\/[0-9]{4}\b` — will post results in the PR checks.
Amelia (Docs): PR title suggestion: "docs: extract v1->v2 deprecation strings for i18n + snippet normalization". Keep changelog in the PR body listing locales.
Lisa (Translations): ETA: translations ready in 4 business days after English PR lands. We might need a back-translation pass for DE/FR.
Marco (PM): Is there any customer-facing timeline text that needs to be carefully worded for legal? We should loop in legal for the English original before we translate.
Amelia (Docs): Good call. I'll ping Legal once draft PR is up.
Sanjay (SDK): One more: some SDK examples call `model: "rwd-text-2"` — if we introduce aliasing for fallback models during deprecation, that needs a short note in docs: "model aliasing may change during sunset". Can we add that to strings.json as `note_model_alias`?
Amelia (Docs): Yes. Add it.
Ryan (i18n): For version-specific phrases like "v1 will be turned off on DATE", use a placeholder token like `{DEPRECATION_DATE}` so translators don't localize the date format. We'll provide a locale-aware rendered date at runtime on the site.
Lisa (Translations): Perfect. We'll translate the sentence but keep `{DEPRECATION_DATE}` intact.
Amelia (Docs): I'll open the English PR now and tag everyone. Expect link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (placeholder). Post status here when PR is up.
docbot: PR created by Amelia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — label: `i18n-deprecation`.
Amelia (Docs): PR is up. Ryan, Sanjay, Lisa — please review and start your actions.
Ryan (i18n): Reviewing now. Found 2 remaining MM/DD/YYYY occurrences in `quickstart.md` lines 45-46. Will patch.
Sanjay (SDK): Patch ready for JS/Python snippets, will open a follow-up PR referencing 1234.
Lisa (Translations): Tracker updated and will open language PRs once 1234 merges.
Marco (PM): Thanks all. We'll target localized rollout same day as English banner. :rocket:
